incompatible-semantic-bundle-late-gate.item: - `verify_release_bundle` calls `verify_checksums` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1728`), which hashes each asset listed in `SHA256SUMS` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2382`); its pack loop decodes each curated manifest and shard (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1733`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1777`), and its generated-production loop calls `verify_generated_production` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1793`), which compares generated schema and cache versions to the current constants (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2059`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2065`).
incompatible-semantic-bundle-late-gate.why: The item says verify_release_bundle hashes every listed asset through verify_checksums (2382) and decodes every curated manifest and shard (1733, 1777) before the generated-production loop calls verify_generated_production (1793). That is the fact's ordering.

python-module-binding-representative-aft.item: - Each module-level assignment to a name builds a `Field` CodeUnit from the module FQN and that name and passes it to `replace_code_unit`, which calls `remove_code_unit` (clearing the unit's `ranges` entry) and then `add_code_unit` with the current assignment node; the unit's stored range is that of the most recently visited assignment for the name (`crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:551`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:569`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:274`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:425`); the event selector reads these ranges through `analyzer.ranges(candidate)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1773`).
python-module-binding-representative-aft.why: The item says every module assignment rebuilds the same Field unit and calls replace_code_unit, which clears its ranges and re-adds it. Only the last assignment's range survives (declarations.rs:551-569, parsed_file.rs:274/425).
